item.title: Blackbeard Low-Cost Hypersonic Missile Testing On The F/A-18 Super Hornet Has Begun
item.summary: The Navy is aiming to have at least a limited operational arsenal of Blackbeard hypersonic missiles within the next two years. The post Blackbeard Low-Cost Hypersonic Missile Testing On The F/A-18 Super Hornet Has Begun appeared first on TWZ .
